title: Binance Copy Trading Adds New USDⓈ-M Contracts (2024-03-19)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Copy Trading will add the following USDⓈ-M contracts at  2024-03-19 09:00 (UTC) .  CAKEUSDT IDUSDT JUPUSDT RONINUSDT Experience Copy Trading Now About Binance Copy Trading Copy Trading  allows users to copy experienced traders’ portfolios in real time. After determining the investment amount, the system will automatically copy trades from the lead traders’ portfolios that the users select. Novice traders may familiarize themselves with the crypto market via Copy Trading, and build up their strategizing and trading techniques.
